issues.jp_before: 田中[たなか]さん、日本[にほん]{の|no-possessive}歌[うた]{を|o-object}歌[うた]う{の/こと|no-nominalizer}{が|ga-stative}好[す]き{ですか|ka-question}。
issues.problem: The ka-question slot contained です as well as か; the slot must hold only the particle.
issues.action: Changed it to 好きです{か|ka-question}.

issues.jp_before: 外国[がいこく]{に/へ|ni-destination}旅行[りょこう]する{の/こと|no-nominalizer}{は|wa-topic}面白[おもしろ]い{ですか|ka-question}。
issues.problem: The ka-question slot contained です as well as か.
issues.action: Changed it to 面白いです{か|ka-question}.

issues.jp_before: 毎日[まいにち]日本語[にほんご]{を|o-object}勉強[べんきょう]する{の/こと|no-nominalizer}{は|wa-topic}大変[たいへん]{ですか|ka-question}。
issues.problem: The ka-question slot contained です as well as か.
issues.action: Changed it to 大変です{か|ka-question}.

issues.jp_before: 新[あたら]しい言葉[ことば]{を|o-object}覚[おぼ]える{の/こと|no-nominalizer}{は|wa-topic}楽[たの]しい{ですが|ga-but}、使[つか]う{の/こと|no-nominalizer}{は|wa-contrast}難[むずか]しいです。
issues.problem: The ga-but slot contained です as well as が.
issues.action: Changed it to 楽しいです{が|ga-but}.

issues.jp_before: 私[わたし]{は|wa-topic}人前[ひとまえ]{で|de-place}話[はな]す{の|no-nominalizer}{が|ga-stative}苦手[にがて]です。
issues.problem: 話すことが苦手 is just as natural, but こと was not listed as an alternative in the focus slot.
issues.action: Changed the focus slot to {の/こと|no-nominalizer}.

issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]遅[おそ]く食[た]べる{の|no-nominalizer}{は|wa-topic}よくないです。
issues.problem: For a general statement, 食べることはよくない is just as natural, but こと was not listed as an alternative.
issues.action: Changed the focus slot to {の/こと|no-nominalizer}.

issues.jp_before: 部屋[へや]{を|o-object}掃除[そうじ]する{の|no-nominalizer}{が|ga-subject}今日[きょう]{の|no-possessive}仕事[しごと]です。
issues.problem: こと is just as natural (and often preferred) in a sentence equating the activity with a noun, and は is an equally natural choice for the subject slot; neither was listed.
issues.action: Changed the slots to {の/こと|no-nominalizer}{が/は|ga-subject}.

issues.jp_before: 兄[あに]{が|ga-sub-clause}台所[だいどころ]{で|de-place}歌[うた]う{の|no-nominalizer}{を|o-object}聞[き]きました。
issues.problem: The why was wrong: it said こと would mean 'hearing that he sings', but 歌うことを聞いた is simply ungrammatical; 'hearing that' is と聞く.
issues.action: Rewrote the why: with 聞く, a sound heard as it happens takes の, and こと cannot follow a verb of direct perception.

issues.jp_before: 窓[まど]{から|kara-from}子[こ]ども{が|ga-sub-clause}走[はし]る{の|no-nominalizer}{を|o-object}見[み]ました。
issues.problem: The English says 'saw a child running' (an action in progress); 走るのを見た is stilted for that.
issues.action: Changed the verb to 走っている.

issues.jp_before: 隣[となり]{の|no-possessive}家[いえ]{で|de-place}赤[あか]ちゃん{が|ga-sub-clause}泣[な]く{の|no-nominalizer}{が|ga-sense}聞[き]こえました。
issues.problem: The English says 'heard a baby crying' (an action in progress); 泣くのが聞こえた is less natural than the progressive form.
issues.action: Changed the verb to 泣いている.
